name: Plan B to U
original_name: จากศัตรูสู่ที่รัก
overview: With his life savings, Yu purchases a house owned by Krit, the CEO of record company Rabbit Hole, for a bargain price. However, it turns out the house is haunted. Yu tries to return the sale, but Krit refuses, so Yu comes up with a plan B: land an internship at Rabbit Hole and exact his revenge.
